description: This is a Java test source file for the ContextDAO component within the OpenMRS project. It contains unit tests for the authentication mechanisms, session listeners, and integration with the database layer related to user authentication and context management.

classes.name: ContextDAOTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the ContextDAO's authentication logic and session event handling in OpenMRS.

classes.name: TestUserSessionListener
classes.description: Inner class implementing UserSessionListener to track login and logout events during tests.

methods.name: runExtraSetup
methods.description: Setup method run before each test to initialize test data and retrieve the DAO bean.

methods.name: logOutAfterThisTest
methods.description: Static method executed after all tests to ensure user is logged out.
